verses.ar: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡخَبِيۡرُ
verses.en: Praise be to Allah, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth; and for Him is the praise in the Hereafter, and He is the Wise, the All-Aware.

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنۡزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيۡهَاؕ وَهُوَ الرَّحِيۡمُ الۡغَفُوۡرُ
verses.en: He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out from it, and all that comes down from the sky and all that ascends thereto. He is the Very-Merciful, the Most-Forgiving.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا السَّاعَةُؕ قُلۡ بَلٰي وَرَبِّيۡ لَتَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡۙ عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِۚ لَا يَعۡزُبُ عَنۡهُ مِثۡقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا٘ اَصۡغَرُ مِنۡ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا٘ اَكۡبَرُ اِلَّا فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: Said those who disbelieve, “The Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment) will not come to us.” Say, “Why not? By my Lord, the knower of the Unseen, it will come to you.” Nothing in the heavens and in the earth, even to the measure of a particle, can escape Him, nor is there anything smaller than that or bigger, but it is recorded in a manifest book.

verses.ar: لِّيَجۡزِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّرِزۡقٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
verses.en: (The Hour will come,) so that He rewards those who believed and did righteous deeds. For such people, there is forgiveness (from Allah) and a noble provision.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ سَعَوۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيۡنَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مِّنۡ رِّجۡزٍ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: As for those who strived against Our signs to defeat (the messenger), for such people there is a painful punishment of the divine wrath.

verses.ar: وَيَرَي الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ هُوَ الۡحَقَّۙ وَيَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلٰي صِرَاطِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِ
verses.en: Those who are blessed with knowledge see that what is sent to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides (people) to the path of the All-Mighty, the Ever-Praised.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هَلۡ نَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ يُّنَبِّئُكُمۡ اِذَا مُزِّقۡتُمۡ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍۙ اِنَّكُمۡ لَفِيۡ خَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍۚ‏
verses.en: And the disbelievers said, “Shall we point out to you a man who informs you that, when you are totally torn into pieces, you shall be (raised) in a new creation?”

verses.ar: اَفۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَمۡ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌؕ بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ فِي الۡعَذَابِ وَالضَّلٰلِ الۡبَعِيۡدِ
verses.en: Has he forged a lie against Allah, or is there a madness in him?” No, but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in torment and far astray from the right path.

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلٰي مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نَخۡسِفۡ بِهِمُ الۡاَرۡضَ اَوۡ نُسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبۡدٍ مُّنِيۡبٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Have they not, then, looked to the sky and the earth that lies before them and behind them? If We so will, We would make the earth swallow them up, or cause pieces of the sky to fall upon them. Surely, in this there is a sign for a servant (of Allah) who turns to Him.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ مِنَّا فَضۡلًاؕ يٰجِبَالُ اَوِّبِيۡ مَعَهٗ وَالطَّيۡرَۚ وَاَلَنَّا لَهُ الۡحَدِيۡدَۙ‏
verses.en: Surely We bestowed grace on Dawūd from Us: “O mountains, pronounce with him Allah’s purity repeatedly - and you too O birds!” And We made the iron soft for him

verses.ar: اَنِ اعۡمَلۡ سٰبِغٰتٍ وَّقَدِّرۡ فِي السَّرۡدِ وَاعۡمَلُوۡا صَالِحًاؕ اِنِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
verses.en: (saying to him,) “Make coats of armour, and maintain balance in combining rings, and do, all of you, righteous deeds. Surely I am watchful of what you do.”

verses.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمٰنَ الرِّيۡحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهۡرٌ وَّرَوَاحُهَا شَهۡرٌۚ وَاَسَلۡنَا لَهٗ عَيۡنَ الۡقِطۡرِؕ وَمِنَ الۡجِنِّ مَنۡ يَّعۡمَلُ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّزِغۡ مِنۡهُمۡ عَنۡ اَمۡرِنَا نُذِقۡهُ مِنۡ عَذَابِ السَّعِيۡرِ
verses.en: And for Sulaimān (We subjugated) the wind; its journey in the morning was (equal to the journey of) one month, and its journey in the afternoon was (equal to the journey) of another month. And We caused a stream of copper to flow for him. And there were some Jinns who worked before him with the leave of his Lord. Whoever of them would deviate from Our command, We would make him taste the punishment of the blazing fire.

verses.ar: يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ لَهٗ مَا يَشَآءُ مِنۡ مَّحَارِيۡبَ وَتَمَاثِيۡلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالۡجَوَابِ وَقُدُوۡرٍ رّٰسِيٰتٍؕ اِعۡمَلُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ دَاوٗدَ شُكۡرًاؕ وَقَلِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُوۡرُ
verses.en: They used to make for him whatever he wished of castles, images, basins as (large as) tanks, and big cookware fixed (in their places). “Do good, O family of Dawūd, in thankfulness. Very few from My slaves are thankful.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا قَضَيۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ الۡمَوۡتَ مَا دَلَّهُمۡ عَلٰي مَوۡتِهٖ٘ اِلَّا دَآبَّةُ الۡاَرۡضِ تَاۡكُلُ مِنۡسَاَتَهٗۚ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الۡجِنُّ اَنۡ لَّوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ الۡغَيۡبَ مَا لَبِثُوۡا فِي الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُهِيۡنِ
verses.en: So, when We decided (that) death (should come) upon him, nothing gave them any indication of his death, except a creature of the earth that had eaten up his sceptre. So, when he fell down, the Jinns came to know that if they had the knowledge of the Unseen, they would not have stayed (so long) in the humiliating punishment.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لِسَبَاٍ فِيۡ مَسۡكَنِهِمۡ اٰيَةٌۚ جَنَّتٰنِ عَنۡ يَّمِيۡنٍ وَّشِمَالٍ ࣢ؕ كُلُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَاشۡكُرُوۡا لَهٗؕ بَلۡدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَّرَبٌّ غَفُوۡرٌ
verses.en: There was indeed a sign for (the community of) Saba’ in their home-land: two gardens, (one) on the right and (one) on the left. “Eat of the provision from your Lord, and be grateful to Him - (You have) an excellent city, and a Most-Forgiving Lord.”

verses.ar: فَاَعۡرَضُوۡا فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَيۡلَ الۡعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلۡنٰهُمۡ بِجَنَّتَيۡهِمۡ جَنَّتَيۡنِ ذَوَاتَيۡ اُكُلٍ خَمۡطٍ وَّاَثۡلٍ وَّشَيۡءٍ مِّنۡ سِدۡرٍ قَلِيۡلٍ
verses.en: Then they turned away. So We sent to them the flood of the dam, and replaced their two gardens with two gardens having fruits of bitter taste, and tamarisk and some bushes of wild lotes.

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِمَا كَفَرُوۡاؕ وَهَلۡ نُجٰزِيۡ٘ اِلَّا الۡكَفُوۡرَ
verses.en: Thus We punished them because of their ungratefulness. We do not give (such a) punishment but to the ungrateful.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ الۡقُرَي الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا قُرًي ظَاهِرَةً وَّقَدَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا السَّيۡرَؕ سِيۡرُوۡا فِيۡهَا لَيَالِيَ وَاَيَّامًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We had set visible townships, all the way between them and the towns blessed by Us, and phased the journey between them in measured phases: “Travel along them at nights and days peacefully.”

verses.ar: فَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا بٰعِدۡ بَيۡنَ اَسۡفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَ وَمَزَّقۡنٰهُمۡ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍ
verses.en: Then they said, “Our Lord, make (the phases of) our journeys more distant.” And they wronged themselves, therefore We turned them into stories, and tore them into pieces. Surely in this there are signs for everyone who is ever-patient, fully grateful.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَدَّقَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اِبۡلِيۡسُ ظَنَّهٗ فَاتَّبَعُوۡهُ اِلَّا فَرِيۡقًا مِّنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Iblīs (Satan)has found his assessment true about them. So they followed him, except a group of the believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ مِنۡهَا فِيۡ شَكٍّؕ وَرَبُّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيۡظٌࣖ‏
verses.en: He did not have any power over them, but for the reason that We should recognize the one who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from the one who is in doubt about it; and your Lord is Watchful over every thing.

verses.ar: قُلِ ادۡعُوا الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا لَهُمۡ فِيۡهِمَا مِنۡ شِرۡكٍ وَّمَا لَهٗ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ ظَهِيۡرٍ
verses.en: Say. “Call upon those whom you claim (to be your gods) beside Allah. They do not possess (any thing) even to the measure of a particle, neither in the heavens nor in the earth. They have no contribution at all in either of the two, nor is any of them a helper for Him (Allah).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَنۡفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنۡدَهٗ٘ اِلَّا لِمَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهٗؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ قَالُوۡا مَاذَاۙ قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡؕ قَالُوا الۡحَقَّۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيُّ الۡكَبِيۡرُ
verses.en: Intercession before Him is of no benefit, but for the one whom He has permitted. (And those who receive a command from Allah remain fearful) until when fear is removed from their hearts, they say (to each other), “What did your Lord say?” They say, “The Truth.” He is the High, the Great.

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُۙ وَاِنَّا٘ اَوۡ اِيَّاكُمۡ لَعَلٰي هُدًي اَوۡ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Say, “Who gives you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah”. And We or you are either on the right path or in open error.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّا تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ عَمَّا٘ اَجۡرَمۡنَا وَلَا نُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “You will not be asked about the sins we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفۡتَحُ بَيۡنَنَا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَهُوَ الۡفَتَّاحُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: Say, “Our Lord will assemble us together, then will judge between us with truth. He is the best Judge, the All-Knowing.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَرُوۡنِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَلۡحَقۡتُمۡ بِهٖ شُرَكَآءَ كَلَّاؕ بَلۡ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: Say, “Show me the ones whom you have associated with Him as partners. Never! (You can never produce such partners.) He is but Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.”

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيۡرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: We did not send you (O prophet,) but to the entire mankind, as a bearer of good news and as a warner, but most people do not know.

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They say, “ When will this promise (of the Day of Judgment) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّكُمۡ مِّيۡعَادُ يَوۡمٍ لَّا تَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ عَنۡهُ سَاعَةً وَّلَا تَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Say, “You hold an appointment for a day that you can neither put back for a while, nor can you put it forward.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡمِنَ بِهٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ مَوۡقُوۡفُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡۚۖ يَرۡجِعُ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اِلٰي بَعۡضِ اِۨلۡقَوۡلَۚ يَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَكُنَّا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Qur’ān, nor in that which was before it.” But if only you could see when the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, repulsing words (of blame) to one another! Those who were held as weak will say to the overbearing, “Had you not been there, we would have been believers.”

verses.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡ٘ا اَنَحۡنُ صَدَدۡنٰكُمۡ عَنِ الۡهُدٰي بَعۡدَ اِذۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بَلۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Those who were overbearing will say to those weak, “Had we stopped you from (accepting) guidance after it came to you? Rather, you yourselves were guilty.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا بَلۡ مَكۡرُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اِذۡ تَاۡمُرُوۡنَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّكۡفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَنَجۡعَلَ لَهٗ٘ اَنۡدَادًاؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا الۡاَغۡلٰلَ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاؕ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And those weak will say to those overbearing, “But (it was your) intriguing day and night (that stopped us from accepting guidance), when you were directing us to disbelieve in Allah and to set up rivals to Him.” And all of them will conceal (their) regrets when they will see the punishment. And We will place iron-collars around the necks of those who disbelieved. They will not be recompensed except for what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَا٘ اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: We did not send a warner to a township, but said those who lived a luxurious life in it, “We reject what you have been sent with.”

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اَكۡثَرُ اَمۡوَالًا وَّاَوۡلَادًاۙ وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِيۡنَ
verses.en: And they said, “We are superior in riches and children, and we are not going to be punished”.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Say, “In fact, my Lord extends provision to whom He wills, and straitens (it for whom He wills), but most of the people do not know”.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَمۡوَالُكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَوۡلَادُكُمۡ بِالَّتِيۡ تُقَرِّبُكُمۡ عِنۡدَنَا زُلۡفٰ٘ي اِلَّا مَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًاؗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءُ الضِّعۡفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوۡا وَهُمۡ فِي الۡغُرُفٰتِ اٰمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Your riches or your children are not the things that bring you near Us closely; however, the one who believes and acts righteously (is close to Us). Therefore, such people will have the double reward for what they did, and they will be at peace in the upper chambers (of Paradise).

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡعَوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيۡنَ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: As for those who strive against our signs trying to frustrate (them), they will be arraigned into the torment.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهٗؕ وَمَا٘ اَنۡفَقۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَهُوَ يُخۡلِفُهٗۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “ Surely, my Lord extends provision for whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it) for him. And whatever thing you spend, He replaces it, and He is the best of the sustainers.

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ يَقُوۡلُ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اَهٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِيَّاكُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Remember) the Day when He will gather all of them together, then will say to the angels, “Is it you that these people used to worship?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ اَنۡتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡۚ بَلۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ الۡجِنَّۚ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ بِهِمۡ مُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say, “Pure are You! You are our mentor, not these. Rather, they used to worship the Jinns. Most of these believed in them.”

verses.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا يَمۡلِكُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ نَّفۡعًا وَّلَا ضَرًّاؕ وَنَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, you have no power today to benefit or harm one another, and We will say to the wrongdoers, “Taste the punishment of the Fire that you used to deny.”

verses.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّصُدَّكُمۡ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُكُمۡۚ وَقَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اِفۡكٌ مُّفۡتَرًيؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۙ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: When Our evident verses are recited to them, they say, “He is nothing but a man who wishes to divert you from what your fathers used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a forged lie.” And the disbelievers say about the Truth, when it came to them, “This is nothing but an explicit magic.”

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ كُتُبٍ يَّدۡرُسُوۡنَهَا وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَبۡلَكَ مِنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍؕ‏
verses.en: We did not give them any books that they might study, nor did We send to them any warner before you.

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡۙ وَمَا بَلَغُوۡا مِعۡشَارَ مَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُوۡا رُسُلِيۡࣞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيۡرِࣖ‏
verses.en: And those before them had rejected (the prophets), while these (infidels of Makkah) have not reached even one tenth of what We gave to those (before them). So, they rejected my Messengers. Then (imagine) how was My censure!

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَعِظُكُمۡ بِوَاحِدَةٍۚ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمُوۡا لِلّٰهِ مَثۡنٰي وَفُرَادٰي ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوۡاࣞ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمۡ مِّنۡ جِنَّةٍؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ
verses.en: Say, “I advise you for one thing only: that you stand up before Allah, in pairs and in singles, then reflect; (you will easily appreciate that) there is no madness in your fellow (the Holy Prophet).” He is none but a warner to you in the face of a stern torment.

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَا سَاَلۡتُكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَجۡرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمۡؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌ
verses.en: Say, “If I had ever claimed any reward from you, then it is yours. My reward is with none but Allah. And He is witness over every thing.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّۚ عَلَّامُ الۡغُيُوۡبِ
verses.en: Say, “My Lord sends forth the Truth. He is the Best-Knower of the Unseen.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ جَآءَ الۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ الۡبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيۡدُ
verses.en: Say, “Truth has come, and falsehood (has vanished, and it) has no power to produce or reproduce (anything).”

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ ضَلَلۡتُ فَاِنَّمَا٘ اَضِلُّ عَلٰي نَفۡسِيۡۚ وَاِنِ اهۡتَدَيۡتُ فَبِمَا يُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيَّ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيۡعٌ قَرِيۡبٌ
verses.en: Say, “If I go astray, I shall go astray only to my own detriment. And if I follow the right path, it is because of what my Lord reveals to me. Surely He is All-Hearer, Ever-Near.”

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذۡ فَزِعُوۡا فَلَا فَوۡتَ وَاُخِذُوۡا مِنۡ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيۡبٍۙ‏
verses.en: And if you could only see when they will be terrified! Then there will be no escape, and they will be seized from a place near at hand.

verses.ar: وَّقَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۚ وَاَنّٰي لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍۚ‏
verses.en: And they will say, “We believe in Him.” And how can they grasp at it (the faith) from a place (so) far off,

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ كَفَرُوۡا بِهٖ مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ وَيَقۡذِفُوۡنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
verses.en: while they had rejected it before, and used to make conjectures from a remote place?

verses.ar: وَحِيۡلَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ مَا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِاَشۡيَاعِهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا فِيۡ شَكٍّ مُّرِيۡبٍࣖ‏
verses.en: And a barrier will be placed between them and that which they desire, as it will be done with the people of their kind who were before (them). They have been in a perplexing doubt.
